entries.title: فهرس القراء والتسجيلات (MP3Quran)
entries.source: mp3quran.net API v3 (snapshot via risan/quran-json) + live refresh from the app
entries.licence: mp3quran.net states no licence for redistribution that we could find; we link to its files and do not copy them.
entries.offlineBundling: Catalogue bundled. Audio files are never bundled or re-hosted; the app streams from mp3quran servers and lets the USER download to their own device (the same function mp3quran.net offers on its site). Re-hosting on a private server is NOT permitted without written consent.
